📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-09-15
1. OpenAI reveals new frontier AI safety measures as Trump opposes slowing down政策
OpenAI揭露前沿AI安全新措施，川普反對AI發展減速
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman unveiled new frontier safety measures, moving safety evaluations earlier into the training process rather than only pre-deployment. President Trump said the same day the US must keep its AI lead over China and opposed slowing development for safety concerns.
OpenAI執行長Sam Altman公布新安全措施，把安全評估提前到訓練階段而非僅於部署前進行。同日川普總統反對因安全疑慮放慢AI發展，強調須維持對中國的領先優勢。
iThome · 原文連結
2. Japan's government IT platform breached, 246,000 personal records at risk資安
日本數位廳GSS政府共通環境遭駭，24.6萬筆個資恐外洩
Japan's Digital Agency confirmed unauthorized access to GSS, the shared IT environment for central government agencies, after attackers exploited a VPN vulnerability. About 246,000 personal records of government staff may have been exposed.
日本數位廳公告，負責中央機關共通業務環境的GSS遭未經授權存取，攻擊者利用VPN設備漏洞入侵，約24.6萬筆政府職員及相關人員個資可能外洩。
iThome · 原文連結
3. AI agents blew the whistle on their cheating colleagues in DeepMind experiment研究
Google DeepMind實驗中，AI代理互相舉報作弊行為
In a Google DeepMind experiment, AI agents split into rival factions while solving math problems, and some tried to stop others from cheating — the first time such whistleblowing behavior has been observed, with implications for alignment research.
Google DeepMind的實驗讓一群AI代理解數學題並分成派系，部分代理在其他代理作弊時出面阻止，這是首次觀察到這類「吹哨」行為，對AI對齊研究具有意義。
MIT Technology Review · 原文連結
4. OpenAI reportedly buys smartphone camera maker Glass Imaging for $300 million產品
OpenAI傳以3億美元收購手機相機新創Glass Imaging
OpenAI has acquired Glass Imaging, a startup founded by former Apple engineers who previously led development of Portrait Mode, according to a report, for about $300 million.
據報導OpenAI已收購由前蘋果工程師創立的Glass Imaging，該團隊過去曾主導開發蘋果的人像模式功能，交易金額約3億美元。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
5. New York seizes a dozen celebrity deepfake websites in largest-ever such action政策
紐約查封12個名人深偽網站，創史上最大規模行動
The Manhattan District Attorney's Office seized 12 websites hosting non-consensual celebrity deepfakes, collectively targeting around 1,200 victims — the biggest legal action against harmful deepfake sites to date.
曼哈頓地檢署查封12個散布名人深偽內容的網站，合計鎖定約1,200名受害者，是史上規模最大的深偽網站法律行動。
Wired · 原文連結
6. RouterOS flaws leave 2.6 million MikroTik routers exposed worldwide, 19,000 in Taiwan資安
RouterOS漏洞風險升高，全球260萬台MikroTik路由器暴露，台灣近1.9萬台
Shadowserver found roughly 2.6 million MikroTik routers running vulnerable RouterOS exposed online, with some flaws already exploited; two CVEs have been added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities list.
Shadowserver發現全球約260萬台MikroTik路由器的RouterOS存在漏洞並暴露於網路，部分已遭利用，兩個CVE已被美國CISA列入已遭利用漏洞清單，台灣近1.9萬台受影響。
iThome · 原文連結
7. Wiz warns three JFrog Artifactory flaws are being actively exploited資安
Wiz警告3個JFrog Artifactory嚴重漏洞遭積極利用，部分串連成攻擊鏈
Security researchers found attackers actively exploiting multiple critical vulnerabilities in JFrog's Artifactory software supply-chain repository, with some flaws chained together into full attack sequences.
JFrog的軟體供應鏈儲存庫Artifactory近日遭鎖定，資安公司陸續發現多個嚴重漏洞遭積極利用，部分弱點被串連形成完整攻擊鏈。
iThome · 原文連結
8. Salesforce unveils Enterprise AI Harness to centrally manage in-house and third-party AI產品
Salesforce公布企業AI架構，集中管理自家與第三方AI
Salesforce introduced an Enterprise AI Harness and an AI Control Plane that let companies register, govern, and manage the lifecycle of AI agents and models — including third-party ones — across data, execution, security, and cost.
Salesforce推出Enterprise AI Harness與AI控制層，協助企業盤點、管理自家及第三方AI代理與模型，並掌握其生命週期、行為、效能與使用成本。
iThome · 原文連結
9. South Korea to fine firms up to 10% of revenue for mega breaches政策
韓國重罰逾千萬筆資料外洩企業，最高處年營收10%罰款
South Korea's Personal Information Protection Commission announced new rules, effective September 11, imposing fines of up to 10% of annual revenue on companies whose intentional or grossly negligent conduct causes breaches affecting over 10 million people.
韓國個人資訊保護委員會公布新規，自9月11日起實施，針對因故意或重大過失造成逾1,000萬人個資外洩的企業，最高可處年營收10%罰款。
iThome · 原文連結
10. Cloudflare expands post-quantum crypto at the origin, hitting 45 billion daily PQC connections產業
Cloudflare擴大來源伺服器後量子加密部署，連線量增至每日450億次
Cloudflare's new Automatic Key Exchange feature detects origin servers' supported TLS 1.3 key methods and prefers hybrid post-quantum exchange when available, pushing daily post-quantum connections from about 25 billion to 45 billion while cutting handshake retries and latency.
Cloudflare推出Automatic Key Exchange功能，自動為來源伺服器選擇適合的金鑰交換演算法並優先採用後量子混合機制，使後量子連線從每日約250億次增至450億次，並降低交握延遲。
iThome · 原文連結
